xgoals.query:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT game_uid, season_uid 
  FROM nhl.shots
  WHERE class IN ('shot-on-goal', 'missed-shot', 'goal') AND shot IS NOT NULL
    AND ( :type IS NULL AND strength IS NOT NULL AND strength != ''
      OR (:type = 'fs' AND strength = '1551')
      OR (:type = 'st' AND SUBSTRING(strength, 4, 1) = '1' AND strength <> '1551')
      OR (:type = 'en' AND SUBSTRING(strength, 4, 1) = '0')
    )
), games AS (
  SELECT
    game_uid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY season_uid ORDER BY RANDOM()) AS uid,
    COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY season_uid) AS total,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY season_uid DESC) AS recency
  FROM src
), inference AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT game_uid
  FROM nhl.shots
  WHERE :train IS NULL AND modified_timestamp > (
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(logs.end), '-infinity'::TIMESTAMP) FROM public.logs logs WHERE logs.execution = CASE WHEN :type IS NULL THEN 'xgoals' ELSE :type || '_xgoals' END
  )
), train AS (
  SELECT
    uid,
    game_uid,
    total,
    CASE
      WHEN recency <= 3 THEN 1.0
      ELSE POWER(CAST(:decay AS NUMERIC), recency - 3)
    END AS ratio
  FROM games
  WHERE :train IS NOT NULL
), metadata AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT game_uid FROM inference
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT game_uid FROM train WHERE uid <= CEIL(total * ratio)
), faceoffs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    src.season_uid,
    src.season_type,
    src.game_uid,
    src.period_number,
    (SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60) + SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 2)::INTEGER AS time_elapsed,
    src.sequence,
    'faceoff' AS event_type,
    src.zone,
    src.x,
    src.y
  FROM nhl.faceoffs src
  JOIN metadata meta
    ON src.game_uid = meta.game_uid
), posessions AS (
  SELECT
    src.season_uid,
    src.season_type,
    src.game_uid,
    src.period_number,
    (SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60) + SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 2)::INTEGER AS time_elapsed,
    src.sequence,
    src.class AS event_type,
    src.zone,
    src.x,
    src.y
  FROM nhl.possessions src
  JOIN metadata meta
    ON src.game_uid = meta.game_uid
), hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    src.season_uid,
    src.season_type,
    src.game_uid,
    src.period_number,
    (SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60) + SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 2)::INTEGER AS time_elapsed,
    src.sequence,
    'hit' AS event_type,
    src.zone,
    src.x,
    src.y
  FROM nhl.hits src
  JOIN metadata meta
    ON src.game_uid = meta.game_uid
), shots AS (
  SELECT
    src.season_uid,
    src.season_type,
    src.game_uid,
    src.period_number,
    (SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60) + SPLIT_PART(src.time_elapsed, ':', 2)::INTEGER AS time_elapsed,
    src.sequence,
    src.class AS event_type,
    src.zone,
    src.x,
    src.y
  FROM nhl.shots src
  JOIN metadata meta
    ON src.game_uid = meta.game_uid
), events AS (
  SELECT * FROM faceoffs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM posessions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM hits
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM shots
), gamelog AS (
  SELECT 
    src.season_uid,
    src.season_type,
    src.game_uid,
    src.period_number,
    src.time_elapsed,
    src.sequence,
    src.event_type,
    src.zone,
    src.x,
    src.y,
    LAG(src.time_elapsed) OVER(PARTITION BY src.season_uid, src.season_type, src.game_uid, src.period_number ORDER BY src.sequence) AS prev_time_elapsed,
    LAG(src.event_type) OVER(PARTITION BY src.season_uid, src.season_type, src.game_uid, src.period_number ORDER BY src.sequence) AS prev_event_type,
    LAG(src.zone) OVER(PARTITION BY src.season_uid, src.season_type, src.game_uid, src.period_number ORDER BY src.sequence) AS prev_zone,
    LAG(src.x) OVER(PARTITION BY src.season_uid, src.season_type, src.game_uid, src.period_number ORDER BY src.sequence) AS prev_x,
    LAG(src.y) OVER(PARTITION BY src.season_uid, src.season_type, src.game_uid, src.period_number ORDER BY src.sequence) AS prev_y
  FROM events src
)

SELECT
  sht.season_uid,
  sht.season_type,
  sht.game_uid,
  sht.sequence,
  SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 2, 1)::INTEGER - SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 3, 1)::INTEGER AS advantage,
  SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 2, 1)::INTEGER + SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 3, 1)::INTEGER AS total,
  CASE
    WHEN sht.zone = 'OZ' AND bio.handedness = 'R' AND sht.y > 0 THEN 1
    WHEN sht.zone = 'OZ' AND bio.handedness = 'L' AND sht.y < 0 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS offwing,
  1 - SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 4, 1)::INTEGER AS empty_net,
  CASE
    WHEN sht.x >= 89 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS behind_net,
  CASE 
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('backhand') THEN 1
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('snap','wrist') THEN 2
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('slap') THEN 3
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('tip-in', 'deflected') THEN 4
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('wrap-around') THEN 5
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('poke') THEN 6
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('cradle') THEN 7
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('between-legs') THEN 8
    WHEN sht.shot IN ('bat') THEN 9
    ELSE NULL
  END AS shot,
  SQRT(POWER(89 - sht.x, 2) + POWER(sht.y, 2)) AS shot_distance,
  ACOSD( ROUND(ABS(sht.y) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(sht.x - 89, 2) + POWER(sht.y, 2)), 0), 5) ) AS shot_angle,
  SQRT(POWER(sht.x - gl.prev_x, 2) + POWER(sht.y - gl.prev_y, 2)) AS event_distance,
  ACOSD( ROUND( (((sht.x - 89) * (gl.prev_x - 89)) + (sht.y * gl.prev_y)) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(sht.x - 89, 2) + POWER(sht.y, 2)) * SQRT(POWER(gl.prev_x - 89, 2) + POWER(gl.prev_y, 2)), 0), 5 ) ) AS event_angle,
  CASE
    WHEN gl.time_elapsed = gl.prev_time_elapsed THEN SQRT(POWER(sht.x - gl.prev_x, 2) + POWER(sht.y - gl.prev_y, 2)) / 0.5
    ELSE SQRT(POWER(sht.x - gl.prev_x, 2) + POWER(sht.y - gl.prev_y, 2)) / (gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed)
  END AS distance_roc,
  CASE
    WHEN gl.time_elapsed = gl.prev_time_elapsed THEN ACOSD( ROUND( (((sht.x - 89) * (gl.prev_x - 89)) + (sht.y * gl.prev_y)) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(sht.x - 89, 2) + POWER(sht.y, 2)) * SQRT(POWER(gl.prev_x - 89, 2) + POWER(gl.prev_y, 2)), 0), 5 ) ) / 0.5
    WHEN (gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed) <= 3 THEN ACOSD( ROUND( (((sht.x - 89) * (gl.prev_x - 89)) + (sht.y * gl.prev_y)) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(sht.x - 89, 2) + POWER(sht.y, 2)) * SQRT(POWER(gl.prev_x - 89, 2) + POWER(gl.prev_y, 2)), 0), 5 ) ) / (gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed)
    ELSE 0
  END AS angle_roc,
  CASE
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('shot-on-goal', 'missed-shot', 'blocked-shot') AND (gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed) <= 3 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS rebound,
  CASE
    WHEN (gl.prev_zone = 'NZ' and (gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed) <= 3) OR (gl.prev_zone = 'DZ' and (gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed) <= 5) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS rush,
  CASE 
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('faceoff') THEN 1
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('giveaway') THEN 2
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('takeaway') THEN 3
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('hit') THEN 4
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('blocked-shot') THEN 5
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('missed-shot') THEN 6
    WHEN gl.prev_event_type IN ('shot-on-goal') THEN 7
    ELSE NULL
  END AS prev_event,
  CASE
    WHEN gl.prev_x >= 89 AND sht.x < 89 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS x_flip,
  CASE
    WHEN SIGN(gl.prev_y) != SIGN(sht.y) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS y_flip,
  gl.time_elapsed - gl.prev_time_elapsed AS time_change,
  ABS(sht.x - gl.prev_x) AS x_change,
  ABS(sht.y - gl.prev_y) AS y_change,
  CASE
    WHEN sht.class = 'goal' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS goal
FROM nhl.shots sht
JOIN gamelog gl
  ON sht.season_uid = gl.season_uid
  AND sht.season_type = gl.season_type
  AND sht.game_uid = gl.game_uid
  AND sht.sequence = gl.sequence
JOIN nhl.bios bio
  ON sht.athlete_uid = bio.athlete_uid
WHERE sht.class IN ('shot-on-goal', 'missed-shot', 'goal') AND sht.shot IS NOT NULL
AND ( :type IS NULL AND sht.strength IS NOT NULL AND sht.strength != ''
  OR (:type = 'fs' AND sht.strength = '1551')
  OR (:type = 'st' AND SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 4, 1) = '1' AND sht.strength <> '1551')
  OR (:type = 'en' AND SUBSTRING(sht.strength, 4, 1) = '0')
)
